dedupe_keys.name: teed ja navigatsiooniinfo road network and navigation database

description: Teed ja navigatsiooniinfo (road network and navigation database) is a dataset listed in Estonian National Geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Maa-amet. The data contained in the Regio Baltic Roads and Navigation Information Database can be used to solve logistical problems, and the database also contains navigation information. Coverage: EE. The portal shows the English title as "Road network and navigation database" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ringteed, Läti, sõidurajad, teed, kõrguspiirangud, juurdepääsupiirangud. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ng-ee.
